classification.difficultyReason: Form and simplify symbolic complements of combined angle expressions.

content.prompt: Determine the missing angle in each diagram in terms of $x$ or $y$.

spec.description: Horizontal straight line and an upper-left ray. The left angle is labelled 180 − 2x; the adjacent unknown has a green unfilled arc.
spec.mathematics: The two adjacent angles sum to 180 degrees. Ray inclination is illustrative.
spec.answerVisibility: Given expression visible; completed answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Missing angle}&=180-(180-2x)\\&=2x\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal straight line and a steep upper-left ray. The left angle is labelled 20 + x; the adjacent unknown has a green unfilled arc.
spec.mathematics: The adjacent angles sum to 180 degrees. Ray inclination is illustrative.
spec.answerVisibility: Given expression visible; completed answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Missing angle}&=180-(20+x)\\&=160-x\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Vertical upward ray, upper-right ray and perpendicular lower-right ray. The small upper angle is x. A green reflex arc travels from the upward ray through the left and lower regions to the lower-right ray.
spec.mathematics: The reflex unknown, x and 90 degrees sum to 360 degrees. The right-angle marker is derived from the two perpendicular diagonal rays.
spec.answerVisibility: x and right-angle marker visible; completed answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles at a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Missing angle}&=360-x-90\\&=270-x\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A straight angle partitioned into three upper sectors by upper-left and steep upper-right rays. Labels from left to right are x + 20, y − 10 and an unlabelled green-arc unknown.
spec.mathematics: The three sectors sum to 180 degrees. Inclinations are illustrative.
spec.answerVisibility: Both givens visible; completed answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Missing angle}&=180-(x+20)-(y-10)\\&=180-x-20-y+10\\&=170-x-y\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A straight angle partitioned by upper-left and upper-right rays. Labels from left to right are x, 150 − y and an unlabelled green-arc unknown.
spec.mathematics: The three sectors sum to 180 degrees. Inclinations are illustrative.
spec.answerVisibility: Both givens visible; completed answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Missing angle}&=180-x-(150-y)\\&=180-x-150+y\\&=30-x+y\end{align*}$$
